// This class computes a {@link ControlFlowGraph} for a given AST
// 
// <p>Example usage:
// 
// <pre>{@code
// ControlFlowGraph<Node> cfg = ControlFlowAnalysis.builder()
//                                  .setCompiler(compiler)
//                                  .setCfgRoot(functionRoot)
//                                  .setShouldIncludeEdgeAnnotations(true)
//                                  .computeCfg())
// }</pre>
type ControlFlowAnalysis struct {
	// Based roughly on the first few pages of
	// 
	// <p>"Declarative Intraprocedural Flow Analysis of Java Source Code by Nilsson-Nyman, Hedin,
	// Magnusson &amp; Ekman",
	// 
	// <p>This pass computes the control flow graph from the AST. However, a full attribute grammar is
	// not necessary. We will compute the flow edges with a single post order traversal. The
	// "follow()" of a given node will be computed recursively in a demand driven fashion.
	// 
	// <p>At the moment, we are not performing any inter-procedural analysis.
	Compiler *Compiler
	Cfg *ControlFlowGraph
	// TODO: Java type LinkedIdentityHashMap<Node, Integer> not mapped
	AstPosition LinkedIdentityHashMap<Node, Integer>
	// TODO: Java type Comparator<DiGraphNode<Node, Branch>> not mapped
	PriorityComparator Comparator<DiGraphNode<Node, Branch>>
	AstPositionCounter int
	PriorityCounter int
	ShouldTraverseFunctions bool
	EdgeAnnotations bool
	Root *rhino.Node
	// Based roughly on the first few pages of
	// 
	// <p>"Declarative Intraprocedural Flow Analysis of Java Source Code by Nilsson-Nyman, Hedin,
	// Magnusson &amp; Ekman",
	// 
	// <p>This pass computes the control flow graph from the AST. However, a full attribute grammar is
	// not necessary. We will compute the flow edges with a single post order traversal. The
	// "follow()" of a given node will be computed recursively in a demand driven fashion.
	// 
	// <p>At the moment, we are not performing any inter-procedural analysis.
	// /
	// private final AbstractCompiler compiler;
	// 
	// private ControlFlowGraph<Node> cfg;
	// 
	// private @Nullable LinkedIdentityHashMap<Node, Integer> astPosition;
	// 
	// // We order CFG nodes by by looking at the AST positions.
	// // CFG nodes that come first lexically should be visited first, because
	// // they will often be executed first in the source program.
	// private final Comparator<DiGraphNode<Node, Branch>> priorityComparator =
	// Comparator.comparingInt(
	// digraphNode ->
	// checkNotNull(astPosition.get(digraphNode.getValue()), digraphNode.getValue()));
	// 
	// private int astPositionCounter;
	// private int priorityCounter;
	// 
	// private final boolean shouldTraverseFunctions;
	// private final boolean edgeAnnotations;
	// 
	// // We need to store where we started, in case we aren't doing a flow analysis
	// // for the whole scope. This happens, for example, when running type inference
	// // on only the externs.
	// private Node root;
	// 
	// /*
	// This stack captures the structure of nested TRY blocks. The top of the
	// stack is the inner most TRY block. A FUNCTION node in this stack implies
	// that the handler is determined by the caller of the function at runtime.
	// TODO: Java type Deque<Node> not mapped
	ExceptionHandler Deque<Node>
	// Based roughly on the first few pages of
	// 
	// <p>"Declarative Intraprocedural Flow Analysis of Java Source Code by Nilsson-Nyman, Hedin,
	// Magnusson &amp; Ekman",
	// 
	// <p>This pass computes the control flow graph from the AST. However, a full attribute grammar is
	// not necessary. We will compute the flow edges with a single post order traversal. The
	// "follow()" of a given node will be computed recursively in a demand driven fashion.
	// 
	// <p>At the moment, we are not performing any inter-procedural analysis.
	// /
	// private final AbstractCompiler compiler;
	// 
	// private ControlFlowGraph<Node> cfg;
	// 
	// private @Nullable LinkedIdentityHashMap<Node, Integer> astPosition;
	// 
	// // We order CFG nodes by by looking at the AST positions.
	// // CFG nodes that come first lexically should be visited first, because
	// // they will often be executed first in the source program.
	// private final Comparator<DiGraphNode<Node, Branch>> priorityComparator =
	// Comparator.comparingInt(
	// digraphNode ->
	// checkNotNull(astPosition.get(digraphNode.getValue()), digraphNode.getValue()));
	// 
	// private int astPositionCounter;
	// private int priorityCounter;
	// 
	// private final boolean shouldTraverseFunctions;
	// private final boolean edgeAnnotations;
	// 
	// // We need to store where we started, in case we aren't doing a flow analysis
	// // for the whole scope. This happens, for example, when running type inference
	// // on only the externs.
	// private Node root;
	// 
	// /*
	// This stack captures the structure of nested TRY blocks. The top of the
	// stack is the inner most TRY block. A FUNCTION node in this stack implies
	// that the handler is determined by the caller of the function at runtime.
	// /
	// private final Deque<Node> exceptionHandler = new ArrayDeque<>();
	// 
	// /*
	// This map is used to handle the follow of FINALLY. For example:
	// 
	// while(x) {
	//  try {
	//    try {
	//      break;
	//    } catch (a) {
	//    } finally {
	//      foo();
	//    }
	//    fooFollow();
	//  } catch (b) {
	//  } finally {
	//    bar();
	//  }
	//  barFollow();
	// }
	// END();
	// 
	// In this case finallyMap will contain a map from:
	//    first FINALLY -> bar()
	//    second FINALLY -> END()
	// 
	// When we are connecting foo() and bar() to to their respective follow, we
	// must also look up this map and connect:
	//   foo() -> bar()
	//   bar() -> END
	// TODO: Java type SetMultimap<Node, Node> not mapped
	FinallyMap SetMultimap<Node, Node>
}

// Constructor. Should only be called from within the {@link Builder}
// 
// Param: compiler Compiler instance.
// Param: shouldTraverseFunctions Whether functions should be traversed
// Param: edgeAnnotations Whether to allow edge annotations.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:85
func NewControlFlowAnalysis(compiler *Compiler, shouldTraverseFunctions bool, edgeAnnotations bool) *ControlFlowAnalysis {
	c := &ControlFlowAnalysis{}
	c.compiler = compiler
	c.shouldTraverseFunctions = shouldTraverseFunctions
	c.edgeAnnotations = edgeAnnotations
	return c
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:137
func Builder() Builder {
	return NewBuilder()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:141
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) GetCfg() *ControlFlowGraph {
	return c.cfg
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:145
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) computeCfg(root *rhino.Node) {
	Preconditions.CheckArgument(NodeUtil.IsValidCfgRoot(root), "Unexpected control flow graph root %s", root)
	c.root = root
	astPosition = NewLinkedIdentityHashMap<>()
	astPositionCounter = 0
	cfg = NewAstControlFlowGraph(ComputeFallThrough(root), edgeAnnotations)
	NodeTraversal.Traverse(compiler, root, c)
	astPosition.Put(nil, astPositionCounter++)
	priorityCounter = 0
	entry := cfg.GetEntry()
	PrioritizeFromEntryNode(entry)
	if shouldTraverseFunctions {
		for _, candidate := range cfg.GetNodes() {
			value := candidate.GetValue()
			if value != nil && value.IsFunction() {
				PrioritizeFromEntryNode(candidate)
			}
		}
	}
	astPosition = nil
	for _, candidate := range cfg.GetNodes() {
		if !candidate.HasPriority() {
			candidate.SetPriority(priorityCounter++)
		}
	}
	cfg.GetImplicitReturn().SetPriority(priorityCounter++)
}

// Given an entry node, find all the nodes reachable from that node and prioritize them.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:194
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) prioritizeFromEntryNode(entry DiGraphNode<Node, Branch>) {
	PriorityQueue < DiGraphNode < Node = NewPriorityQueue<>(10, priorityComparator)
	worklist.Add(entry)
	for !worklist.IsEmpty() {
		current := worklist.Remove()
		if current.HasPriority() {
			continue
		}
		current.SetPriority(priorityCounter++)
		List < ? extends DiGraphNode<Node, Branch>> successors = cfg.GetDirectedSuccNodes(current)
		worklist.AddAll(successors)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:212
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) ShouldTraverse(nodeTraversal *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) bool {
	if ShouldTraverseIntoChildren(n, parent) {
		astPosition.Put(n, astPositionCounter++)
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// Returns whether the children of this node should be traversed as part of this control-flow
// analysis, i.e. whether the control-flow graph being built may require any edges into children
// of this node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:228
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) shouldTraverseIntoChildren(n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) bool {
	switch n.GetToken() {
	}
	if parent != nil {
		switch parent.GetToken() {
		}
		if parent.HasParent() && parent.GetParent().IsArrowFunction() && !parent.IsBlock() {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:325
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) Visit(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) {
	switch n.GetToken() {
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:355
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleIf(node *rhino.Node) {
	thenBlock := node.GetSecondChild()
	elseBlock := thenBlock.GetNext()
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.ON_TRUE, ComputeFallThrough(thenBlock))
	if elseBlock == nil {
		CreateEdge(node, Branch.ON_FALSE, ComputeFollowNode(node, c))
	} else {
		CreateEdge(node, Branch.ON_FALSE, ComputeFallThrough(elseBlock))
	}
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(node, NodeUtil.GetConditionExpression(node))
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:368
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleWhile(node *rhino.Node) {
	cond := node.GetFirstChild()
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.ON_TRUE, ComputeFallThrough(cond.GetNext()))
	if !cond.IsTrue() {
		CreateEdge(node, Branch.ON_FALSE, ComputeFollowNode(node, c))
	}
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(node, NodeUtil.GetConditionExpression(node))
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:380
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleDo(node *rhino.Node) {
	body := node.GetFirstChild()
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.ON_TRUE, ComputeFallThrough(body))
	cond := body.GetNext()
	if !cond.IsTrue() {
		CreateEdge(node, Branch.ON_FALSE, ComputeFollowNode(node, c))
	}
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(node, NodeUtil.GetConditionExpression(node))
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:393
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleEnhancedFor(forNode *rhino.Node) {
	item := forNode.GetFirstChild()
	collection := item.GetNext()
	body := collection.GetNext()
	CreateEdge(collection, Branch.UNCOND, forNode)
	CreateEdge(forNode, Branch.ON_TRUE, ComputeFallThrough(body))
	CreateEdge(forNode, Branch.ON_FALSE, ComputeFollowNode(forNode, c))
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(forNode, collection)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:409
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleFor(forNode *rhino.Node) {
	init := forNode.GetFirstChild()
	cond := init.GetNext()
	iter := cond.GetNext()
	body := iter.GetNext()
	CreateEdge(init, Branch.UNCOND, forNode)
	CreateEdge(forNode, Branch.ON_TRUE, ComputeFallThrough(body))
	if !cond.IsEmpty() && !cond.IsTrue() {
		CreateEdge(forNode, Branch.ON_FALSE, ComputeFollowNode(forNode, c))
	}
	CreateEdge(iter, Branch.UNCOND, forNode)
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(init, init)
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(forNode, cond)
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(iter, iter)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:434
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleSwitch(node *rhino.Node) {
	switchBody := node.GetLastChild()
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, switchBody)
	next := GetNextSiblingOfType(switchBody.GetFirstChild(), Token.CASE, Token.EMPTY)
	if next != nil {
		CreateEdge(switchBody, Branch.UNCOND, next)
	} else {
		if switchBody.HasChildren() {
			CreateEdge(switchBody, Branch.UNCOND, switchBody.GetFirstChild())
		} else {
			CreateEdge(switchBody, Branch.UNCOND, ComputeFollowNode(node, c))
		}
	}
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(node, node.GetFirstChild())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:452
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleCase(caseNode *rhino.Node) {
	CreateEdge(caseNode, Branch.ON_TRUE, caseNode.GetSecondChild())
	next := GetNextSiblingOfType(caseNode.GetNext(), Token.CASE)
	if next != nil {
		CheckState(next.IsCase())
		CreateEdge(caseNode, Branch.ON_FALSE, next)
	} else {
		switchBody := caseNode.GetParent()
		deflt := GetNextSiblingOfType(switchBody.GetFirstChild(), Token.DEFAULT_CASE)
		if deflt != nil {
			CreateEdge(caseNode, Branch.ON_FALSE, deflt)
		} else {
			CreateEdge(caseNode, Branch.ON_FALSE, ComputeFollowNode(caseNode, c))
		}
	}
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(caseNode, caseNode.GetFirstChild())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:473
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleDefault(node *rhino.Node) {
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, node.GetFirstChild())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:478
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleWith(node *rhino.Node) {
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, node.GetLastChild())
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(node, node.GetFirstChild())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:484
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleStmtList(node *rhino.Node) {
	parent := node.GetParent()
	if node.IsBlock() && parent.IsTry() && NodeUtil.GetCatchBlock(parent) == node && !NodeUtil.HasCatchHandler(node) {
		return
	}
	child := node.GetFirstChild()
	for child != nil && child.IsFunction() {
		child = child.GetNext()
	}
	if child != nil {
		CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, ComputeFallThrough(child))
	} else {
		CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, ComputeFollowNode(node, c))
	}
	if parent != nil {
		switch parent.GetToken() {
		}
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:528
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleFunction(node *rhino.Node) {
	CheckState(node.IsFunction())
	CheckState(node.HasXChildren(3))
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, ComputeFallThrough(node.GetLastChild()))
	CheckState(exceptionHandler.Peek() == node)
	exceptionHandler.Pop()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:537
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleExpr(node *rhino.Node) {
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, ComputeFollowNode(node, c))
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(node, node)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:542
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleThrow(node *rhino.Node) {
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(node, node)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:546
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleTry(node *rhino.Node) {
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, node.GetFirstChild())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:550
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleCatch(node *rhino.Node) {
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, node.GetLastChild())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:554
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleBreak(node *rhino.Node) {
	label := nil
	if node.HasChildren() {
		label = node.GetFirstChild().GetString()
	}
	var cur *rhino.Node
	previous := nil
	var lastJump *rhino.Node
	parent := node.GetParent()
	for cur = node; !IsBreakTarget(cur, label); cur = parent {
		if cur.IsTry() && NodeUtil.HasFinally(cur) && cur.GetLastChild() != previous {
			if lastJump == node {
				CreateEdge(lastJump, Branch.UNCOND, ComputeFallThrough(cur.GetLastChild()))
			} else {
				finallyMap.Put(lastJump, ComputeFallThrough(cur.GetLastChild()))
			}
			lastJump = cur
		}
		if parent == nil {
			if compiler.GetOptions().CanContinueAfterErrors() {
				return
			} else {
				panic(NewIllegalStateException("Cannot find break target."))
			}
		}
		previous = cur
	}
	if lastJump == node {
		CreateEdge(lastJump, Branch.UNCOND, ComputeFollowNode(cur, c))
	} else {
		finallyMap.Put(lastJump, ComputeFollowNode(cur, c))
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:602
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleContinue(node *rhino.Node) {
	label := nil
	if node.HasChildren() {
		label = node.GetFirstChild().GetString()
	}
	var cur *rhino.Node
	previous := nil
	var lastJump *rhino.Node
	for cur = node; !IsContinueTarget(cur, label); cur = cur.GetParent() {
		if cur.IsTry() && NodeUtil.HasFinally(cur) && cur.GetLastChild() != previous {
			if lastJump == node {
				CreateEdge(lastJump, Branch.UNCOND, cur.GetLastChild())
			} else {
				finallyMap.Put(lastJump, ComputeFallThrough(cur.GetLastChild()))
			}
			lastJump = cur
		}
		CheckState(cur.HasParent(), "Cannot find continue target.")
		previous = cur
	}
	iter := cur
	if cur.IsVanillaFor() {
		iter = cur.GetChildAtIndex(2)
	}
	if lastJump == node {
		CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, iter)
	} else {
		finallyMap.Put(lastJump, iter)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:637
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleReturn(node *rhino.Node) {
	lastJump := nil
	for _, curHandler := range exceptionHandler {
		if curHandler.IsFunction() {
			break
		}
		if NodeUtil.HasFinally(curHandler) {
			if lastJump == nil {
				CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, curHandler.GetLastChild())
			} else {
				finallyMap.Put(lastJump, ComputeFallThrough(curHandler.GetLastChild()))
			}
			lastJump = curHandler
		}
	}
	if node.HasChildren() {
		ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(node, node.GetFirstChild())
	}
	if lastJump == nil {
		CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, nil)
	} else {
		finallyMap.Put(lastJump, nil)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:664
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) handleStmt(node *rhino.Node) {
	CreateEdge(node, Branch.UNCOND, ComputeFollowNode(node, c))
	ConnectToPossibleExceptionHandler(node, node)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:670
func ComputeFollowNode(node *rhino.Node, cfa ControlFlowAnalysis) *rhino.Node {
	return ComputeFollowNode(node, node, cfa)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:674
func ComputeFollowNode(node *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	return ComputeFollowNode(node, node, nil)
}

// Computes the follow() node of a given node and its parent. There is a side effect when calling
// this function. If this function computed an edge that exists a FINALLY, it'll attempt to
// connect the fromNode to the outer FINALLY according to the finallyMap.
// 
// Param: fromNode The original source node since {@code node} is changed during recursion.
// Param: node The node that follow() should compute.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:686
func computeFollowNode(fromNode *rhino.Node, node *rhino.Node, cfa ControlFlowAnalysis) *rhino.Node {
	parent := node.GetParent()
	if parent == nil || parent.IsFunction() || cfa != nil && node == cfa.root {
		return nil
	}
	switch parent.GetToken() {
	}
	nextSibling := node.GetNext()
	for nextSibling != nil && nextSibling.IsFunction() {
		nextSibling = nextSibling.GetNext()
	}
	if nextSibling != nil {
		return ComputeFallThrough(nextSibling)
	} else {
		return ComputeFollowNode(fromNode, parent, cfa)
	}
}

// Computes the destination node of n when we want to fallthrough into the subtree of n. We don't
// always create a CFG edge into n itself because of DOs and FORs.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:788
func ComputeFallThrough(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	return Switch(n.GetToken())
}

// Connects the two nodes in the control flow graph.
// 
// Param: fromNode Source.
// Param: toNode Destination.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:803
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) createEdge(fromNode *rhino.Node, branch ControlFlowGraph.Branch, toNode *rhino.Node) {
	cfg.CreateNode(fromNode)
	cfg.CreateNode(toNode)
	cfg.ConnectIfNotFound(fromNode, branch, toNode)
}

// Connects cfgNode to the proper CATCH block if target subtree might throw an exception. If there
// are FINALLY blocks reached before a CATCH, it will make the corresponding entry in finallyMap.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:813
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysis) connectToPossibleExceptionHandler(cfgNode *rhino.Node, target *rhino.Node) {
	if MayThrowException(target) && !exceptionHandler.IsEmpty() {
		lastJump := cfgNode
		for _, handler := range exceptionHandler {
			if handler.IsFunction() {
				return
			}
			CheckState(handler.IsTry())
			catchBlock := NodeUtil.GetCatchBlock(handler)
			lastJumpInCatchBlock := false
			for _, ancestor := range lastJump.GetAncestors() {
				if ancestor == handler {
					break
				} else if ancestor == catchBlock {
					lastJumpInCatchBlock = true
					break
				}
			}
			if !NodeUtil.HasCatchHandler(catchBlock) || lastJumpInCatchBlock {
				if lastJump == cfgNode {
					CreateEdge(cfgNode, Branch.ON_EX, handler.GetLastChild())
				} else {
					finallyMap.Put(lastJump, handler.GetLastChild())
				}
			} else {
				if lastJump == cfgNode {
					CreateEdge(cfgNode, Branch.ON_EX, catchBlock)
					return
				} else {
					finallyMap.Put(lastJump, catchBlock)
				}
			}
			lastJump = handler
		}
	}
}

// Get the next sibling (including itself) of one of the given types.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:854
func getNextSiblingOfType(first *rhino.Node, types []rhino.Token) *rhino.Node {
	for c := first; c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
		for _, typ := range types {
			if c.GetToken() == typ {
				return c
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Checks if target is actually the break target of labeled continue. The label can be null if it
// is an unlabeled break.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:869
func IsBreakTarget(target *rhino.Node, label string) bool {
	return IsBreakStructure(target, label != nil) && MatchLabel(target.GetParent(), label)
}

// Checks if target is actually the continue target of labeled continue. The label can be null if
// it is an unlabeled continue.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:877
func IsContinueTarget(target *rhino.Node, label string) bool {
	return NodeUtil.IsLoopStructure(target) && MatchLabel(target.GetParent(), label)
}

// Check if label is actually referencing the target control structure. If label is null, it
// always returns true.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:885
func matchLabel(target *rhino.Node, label string) bool {
	if label == nil {
		return true
	}
	for target.IsLabel() {
		if target.GetFirstChild().GetString().Equals(label) {
			return true
		}
		target = target.GetParent()
	}
	return false
}

// Determines if the subtree might throw an exception.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:899
func MayThrowException(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	switch n.GetToken() {
	}
	for c := n.GetFirstChild(); c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
		if !ControlFlowGraph.IsEnteringNewCfgNode(c) && MayThrowException(c) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// Determines whether the given node can be terminated with a BREAK node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:930
func IsBreakStructure(n *rhino.Node, labeled bool) bool {
	return Switch(n.GetToken())
}

// Get the TRY block with a CATCH that would be run if n throws an exception.
// 
// Returns: The CATCH node or null if it there isn't a CATCH before the function terminates.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:943
func GetExceptionHandler(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	for cur := n; !cur.IsScript() && !cur.IsFunction(); cur = cur.GetParent() {
		catchNode := GetCatchHandlerForBlock(cur)
		if catchNode != nil {
			return catchNode
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Locate the catch BLOCK given the first block in a TRY.
// 
// Returns: The CATCH node or null there is no catch handler.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:958
func GetCatchHandlerForBlock(block *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	if block.IsBlock() && block.GetParent().IsTry() && block.GetParent().GetFirstChild() == block {
		for s := block.GetNext(); s != nil; s = s.GetNext() {
			if NodeUtil.HasCatchHandler(s) {
				return s.GetFirstChild()
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Configures a {@link ControlFlowAnalysis} instance then computes the {@link ControlFlowGraph}
// Inner class ControlFlowAnalysis.Builder — ported as ControlFlowAnalysisBuilder.
type ControlFlowAnalysisBuilder struct {
	Compiler *Compiler
	CfgRoot *rhino.Node
	ShouldTraverseFunctions bool
	EdgeAnnotations bool
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:7
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysisBuilder) builder() {
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:10
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysisBuilder) SetCompiler(compiler *Compiler) Builder {
	c.compiler = compiler
	return c
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:16
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysisBuilder) SetCfgRoot(cfgRoot *rhino.Node) Builder {
	c.cfgRoot = cfgRoot
	return c
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:22
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysisBuilder) SetTraverseFunctions(shouldTraverseFunctions bool) Builder {
	c.shouldTraverseFunctions = shouldTraverseFunctions
	return c
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:28
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysisBuilder) SetIncludeEdgeAnnotations(includeEdgeAnnotations bool) Builder {
	c.edgeAnnotations = includeEdgeAnnotations
	return c
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:33
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysisBuilder) ComputeCfg() *ControlFlowGraph {
	Preconditions.CheckNotNull(compiler, "Need to call setCompiler()")
	Preconditions.CheckNotNull(cfgRoot, "Need to call setCfgRoot()")
	cfa := NewControlFlowAnalysis(compiler, shouldTraverseFunctions, edgeAnnotations)
	cfa.ComputeCfg(c.cfgRoot)
	return cfa.cfg
}

// A {@link ControlFlowGraph} which provides a node comparator based on the pre-order traversal of
// the AST.
// Inner class ControlFlowAnalysis.AstControlFlowGraph — ported as ControlFlowAnalysisAstControlFlowGraph.
type ControlFlowAnalysisAstControlFlowGraph struct {
}

// Constructs this graph.
// 
// Param: entry The entry node.
// Param: edgeAnnotations Annotation
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:9
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysisAstControlFlowGraph) astControlFlowGraph(entry *rhino.Node, edgeAnnotations bool) {
	super
}

// Returns a node comparator based on the pre-order traversal of the AST.
// 
// Param: isForward x 'before' y in the pre-order traversal implies x 'less than' y (if true)
//     and x 'greater than' y (if false).
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java:20
func (c *ControlFlowAnalysisAstControlFlowGraph) GetOptionalNodeComparator(isForward bool) Comparator<DiGraphNode<Node, Branch>> {
	return func() any { if isForward { return Comparator < DiGraphNode < Node }; return ??? }()
}
